core_meaning.primary_meaning: Afaaf corresponds to the Arabic form عفاف and is glossed in this record as “Chastity, modesty, virtue.” The record associates the form with root ع ف ف (ʿ-f-f). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Afaaf corresponds to the Arabic form عفاف (Arabic root ع ف ف (ʿ-f-f); عِفَاف (ʿifāf)). Its core sense is chastity, modesty; virtue. Afaaf is Arabic عِفَاف (ʿifāf) 'Chastity, modesty, virtue', the verbal noun of عَفّ (ʿaffa, 'to abstain, to be chaste') from the geminate root ع ف ف (ʿ-f-f).

etymology.morphology: Verbal noun (maṣdar) of عَفّ (ʿaffa, 'to abstain, to be chaste'), from the geminate root ع ف ف.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ع ف ف (ʿ-f-f)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form عفاف is an established Arabic lexical item — the verbal noun of the root ع ف ف — and Afaaf is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

persian.name: عفاف
persian.long_meaning: Afaaf (عفاف) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن عفت، پاکدامنی، پرهیزگاری است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
